description: This file implements a DIDManager class for managing Decentralized Identifiers (DID) within the AgentField SDK. It includes data classes for DID identities and execution contexts, and methods for registration, resolution, and context creation related to DIDs.

classes.name: DIDIdentity
classes.description: Represents a DID identity with cryptographic keys.

classes.name: DIDIdentityPackage
classes.description: Contains all DID identities associated with an agent, including reasoners and skills.

classes.name: DIDExecutionContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a DID-enabled execution session.

classes.name: DIDManager
classes.description: Manages DID operations such as registration, resolution, and context creation for AgentField SDK agents.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DIDManager with server URL, node ID, and optional API key.

methods.name: _get_auth_headers
methods.description: Returns authentication headers if API key is configured.

methods.name: register_agent
methods.description: Registers the agent with the server and retrieves the DID identity package.

methods.name: create_execution_context
methods.description: Creates a DID-enabled execution context with caller and target DIDs.

methods.name: get_function_did
methods.description: Retrieves the DID for a specified function (reasoner or skill).

methods.name: resolve_did
methods.description: Resolves a DID to its public document.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the DID system is enabled and configured.

methods.name: get_identity_summary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the identity package for debugging.

methods.name: _parse_identity_package
methods.description: Parses the identity package data from registration response.

methods.name: _get_function_did
methods.description: Internal method to get DID for a function by name.
